recognize_zh: CD20 免疫染色：大量背景小 B 淋巴球呈強膜陽性，而散在成群、細胞質淡染的大型漿母細胞樣細胞為陰性，在棕色背景中形成「空洞」般的淡色區；大細胞不表現 CD20 是 germinotropic LPD（與 PEL）的典型表型。
features: Strong membranous CD20 staining in numerous small background B lymphocytes
Clusters of large cells with abundant pale cytoplasm are CD20 negative
Negative large-cell aggregates create pale 'holes' within the brown-staining follicular B-cell population
Endothelial-lined vessels and interstitial areas are negative
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD20 shows strong membranous staining of numerous small B lymphocytes, while the admixed clusters of large atypical cells with abundant pale cytoplasm are negative, producing pale unstained aggregates within the CD20-positive background. Vessels and stromal cells are negative. Loss of pan-B-cell antigen expression by the large cells indicates a plasmablastic phenotype. Together with HHV8 LANA-1, EBER and MUM1 positivity, the findings are consistent with HHV8-positive germinotropic lymphoproliferative disorder.

ddx.vs: In THRLBCL the scattered large cells are CD20 positive within a CD20-poor T-cell background, the opposite of this pattern.
NLPHL LP cells are CD20 positive and sit within nodules of small B cells, and are HHV8/EBV negative.
HRS cells are usually CD20 negative but are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and lack HHV8.
